front.title: Segment Routing Header TLVs for 3GPP Mobility Metadata

abstract.t: This document requests two Segment Routing Header (SRH) TLV codepoints. Both are containers for mobility metadata used by 3GPP user-plane functions. One does not change en route. The other may change en route. This document specifies the framing so that any Segment Routing node can skip either container. Sub-TLV types and their meaning are under 3GPP change control. Neither container changes IPv6 forwarding.
